name: Normative sub-laws of the Republic of Armenia (government and prime-minister decisions, ministerial orders)
label: Armenia (sub-laws)
record_note: 13162 normative acts on ARLIS (9760 government decisions, 136 prime-minister decisions, 3266 ministerial orders), every consolidated text, to the in-force date of 2026-10-29; data built 2026-10-29.

dates.commit: in-force (start of the period ARLIS gives each consolidated text)

author.amendment: the amending act (ARLIS pairs each consolidated text with one act)

scope.when_absent: not extracted for Armenia yet; transitional provisions are in the amending act at the Source link

default_reach.rule: no retroactive effect unless the act says so, and never to worsen a person's position
default_reach.meaning: a legal act applies to relations that arise after it takes effect; it has retroactive force only where the act provides for it, and acts that establish or aggravate liability or worsen a person's legal position have no retroactive force
default_reach.authority: Constitution of the Republic of Armenia (2015), article 73; Law on Normative Legal Acts (ՀՕ-180-Ն, 2018), article 28, which covers every normative legal act, sub-laws included; on transitional provisions, article 13(6)

companion: lexifina/armenia-law (am/national/acts): the Constitution, codes and laws
